content: {"action": "INVESTIGATE", "reason": "Round 2: the t3 logs scan and t4 metrics scan returned only isolated, non-mechanistic observations. The changes scope is already exhausted (broad, completed, 0 records) and postgres telemetry returned NO_DATA, so no unseen records remain in those scopes. No cause-specific discriminator or supported mechanism is observed, so neither FINALIZE nor ABSTAIN is warranted. The two competing hypotheses, backend_resource_saturation and payment_external_timeout, differ on whether a payment-side signal leads backend degradation; payment-side telemetry has never been sampled and is the decisive untreated causal source.
